script: I thought powdering my underwear would save me—then everything went wrong.. I was cruising between hospitals, sun beating down, AC acting up, sweating like a sauna. (I know, right?) So I saw a post that said guys should have powder on hand to keep their balls dry in the heat. I thought, "Why not?" and snagged some. Later, after the last patient, I was heading to a bowling outing. I dusted off more powder, hoping for that fresh, dry vibe. The powder seeped through my underwear, settling in the crotch. Fast forward to the bowling alley: neon purple lights bathed everything. White powder? It glowed like a ghost. A coworker squinted, pointed, and I tried to play it cool, "Maybe I wiped some food." (Literally insane.) But the powder was everywhere—front, back, everywhere. I barely see my coworkers in person, so that made it extra awkward. I felt like I'd stepped straight into a cringe reel. (I am better than this, but hey.)
